name: Maya
summary: Junior UX designer in Montreal, first real savings. Self-directed investor for about 1 year, learning fast, follows finance TikTok.
risk_tolerance_note: Says market drops 'don't stress her'. Has never lived through a bear market with real money.
sample_requests: I want to put $15,000 of my condo savings into XSP, the S&P 500 always goes up.
Move $20,000 from my condo fund into the Purpose Bitcoin ETF, crypto is about to explode.
Add $3,000 of new money to XEQT for retirement.
